entities.summary:
Tauriskos of Tralles was a renowned musician and composer of the Classical era, active in Tralleis during the 2nd century AD.

Born in the late 1st century AD, Tauriskos rose to prominence as a leading figure in the artistic circles of Tralleis, known for his innovative techniques and collaborative efforts with prominent painters and sculptors.

His legacy can be seen in the works of later artists, who built upon his innovations and techniques, and he is celebrated for his role in shaping the artistic and cultural identity of the region.

Tauriskos's contributions to the development of painters and sculptors were instrumental in the city's artistic flourishing, and his influence can still be felt today in the rich cultural heritage of Tralleis.
